description: This is a PHP source file defining the WorkShiftEmployeeAPI class, which is part of an HRM system's API layer for managing employee work shift assignments. It extends a generic Endpoint class and implements collection retrieval functionality for employees unassigned to specific work shifts, including validation and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: WorkShiftEmployeeAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for retrieving employee data related to work shifts, especially employees unassigned to a given shift. Provides methods for listing employees with validation, and stubs for create and delete actions.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a list of employees unassigned to work shifts, with support for filtering by name or ID, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' method parameters, specifically for the 'nameOrId' filter and sorting parameters.
